description: Wait for one or more video tasks to reach a terminal state: blocks until every taskId completes (state 1) or fails (state -1, or gone from the engine), or the timeout elapses. Returns {summary, allTerminal, timedOut, results} with one entry per taskId: {task_id, state, outcome, progress, stage, error}. error is the engine failure reason when outcome is failed. Use after generate_persona_video or generate_persona_video_batch instead of polling get_video_task_progress. On timeout the results are partial: call again with the unfinished taskIds.

taskIds.description: Engine task IDs from generate_persona_video or generate_persona_video_batch, one per video.

timeoutSeconds.description: Longest to wait for all tasks to finish, in seconds. Defaults to 120.

name: wait_for_video_tasks
